name: Pilbara Systems Internet
summary: WAIA member 2000; listed with WAIX as 'Pilbara Internet / Norcom'; site (pilbara.net.au, a dotnet dotau Pty Ltd service) went to a hosting default page Dec 2003, then Concept Networks 2004-06; domain later to Primus.

events.details: Regional WA ISP serving North West towns, late 1990s.
Site down Dec 2003; replaced by Concept Networks 2004-06.
